name: Annal Gandhi Memorial Award
description: Award for Adi Dravidar Hindu students securing 1st rank in 12th Public Examinations.

eligibility.details: Hindu AD students who secured first rank in 12th Std. Public Exams in their district

name: Adi Dravidar & Tribal Welfare Scholarship (Free Education)
description: Free education up to 12th standard for eligible students.

eligibility.details: Adi Dravidar/Tribal/Adi Dravidar Converted to Christianity students; no income limit

eligibility.details: Parents' income ≤ Rs. 1,00,000; student from Most Backward Classes and Denotified Communities

name: Adi Dravidar & Tribal Welfare Scholarship (Public Exams)
description: Covers examination fees for 10th and 12th Std. students in Adi Dravidar/Tribal communities.

eligibility.details: Adi Dravidar/Tribal/Adi Dravidar Converted to Christianity students; no income limit

name: Pragathi Scholarship for Girl Students (Technical Diploma)
description: Scholarship for girl students pursuing technical diplomas, covering tuition, examination, and other incidental expenses.

eligibility.details: Female students from families with income < Rs. 8 Lakh; maximum duration varies depending on entry year

name: Pre-Matric Scholarship Scheme for financially challenged students
description: Aimed at promoting school education among financially challenged students.

eligibility.details: Parents' income ≤ Rs. 1,00,000; no graduate in the family; students in 6th to 10th Std.

name: Free Education Scholarship for Professional Courses
description: Financial assistance for students pursuing professional courses.

eligibility.details: Parents' income ≤ Rs. 1,00,000; no graduate in the family; Backward Classes, Most Backward Classes, and Denotified Communities students

name: Awards to Bright Students
description: Financial reward for students excelling in 10th Public Examinations.

eligibility.details: First two boys and girls in each district from Adi Dravidar, Tribal, or Adi Dravidar Converted to Christianity communities

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for Students with Disabilities
description: Assistance including scholarship, book grant, and escort/reader allowance for disabled students continuing education.

eligibility.details: Students progressing within the same stage of education

name: Begum Hazrat Mahal National Scholarship for Minority Girls
description: Financial aid for minority community girls for educational expenses, including fees, books, and lodging.

eligibility.details: Minority community girls (Muslims, Christians, Sikhs, Buddhists, Jains, Parsis) in class IX to XII; family income ≤ Rs. 2 lakh

name: Saksham Scholarship for Specially-Abled Students (Degree)
description: Support for differently-abled students in technical degree programs to pursue further education.

eligibility.details: Differently-abled students with ≥ 40% disability

name: Scheme for Meritorious Students (Higher Secondary)
description: Financial aid for high-scoring students from government schools to pursue higher education in top private schools.

eligibility.details: Top 10 students from government high schools in each district with parental income ≤ Rs. 1 lakh

name: Free Laptop Scheme
description: Government program providing laptops to students with high marks to promote digital literacy and skill development.

eligibility.details: Students who passed 10th or 12th Std. with ≥ 75% marks

name: Top Class Education Scheme
description: Financial aid for SC students pursuing post-secondary education in reputable institutions.

eligibility.details: SC students with family income ≤ Rs. 8 lakh

name: National Overseas Scholarship for Scheduled Castes
description: Scholarship for low-income SC students to pursue Master's or Ph.D. programs abroad.

eligibility.details: SC students with family income less than Rs. 8 lakh; minimum 60% marks in qualifying exam

name: Merit Cum Means Scholarship (Technical Courses for Minorities)
description: Financial aid for minority students pursuing professional/technical courses.

eligibility.details: Minority students (Muslims, Christians, Sikhs, Buddhists, Jains, Parsis) in class IX-XII with family income ≤ Rs. 2 lakh

name: Free Education Scheme (Degree)
description: Free education for Backward, Most Backward, and Denotified students in 3-year UG courses in government and aided arts/science colleges.

eligibility.details: Backward, Most Backward, Denotified students in 3-year degree programs

name: National Merit Scholarship Scheme
description: Scholarships to meritorious students in class 12th with excellent academic records.

eligibility.details: Students from Class 12th with high marks in exams

name: AICTE-SWANATH Scholarship (Technical Diploma)
description: Support for orphaned students, COVID-19-affected students, and children of martyred armed forces/paramilitary personnel in technical diploma courses.

eligibility.details: First- or second-year students in AICTE-approved diploma courses

name: Book Bank
description: Book lending scheme for SC/ST students to reduce dropout/failure rates due to lack of textbooks.

eligibility.details: SC/ST students receiving the Government of India Scholarship

name: Free Education Scholarship (Polytechnic)
description: Free education for eligible backward classes in polytechnic courses.

eligibility.details: Parents' income ≤ Rs. 1,00,000; no diploma/graduate in family; Backward, Most Backward, and Denotified Communities students

name: Assistance for Education
description: Financial aid for meritorious students with family income ≤ Rs. 4.5 lakh per annum.

eligibility.details: Children of Folk Artistes, maximum of 2 per family starting from Class X

name: Adi Dravidar and Tribal Welfare Department -Hostels - Special Guides
description: Support for boys/girls studying up to XII Standard

eligibility.details: All Boys/Girls Boarders studying up to XII Standard

name: Adi Dravidar and Tribal Welfare Department -Incentive / Award of Prizes - District Level
description: Awards for the highest marks in Plus 2 and 10th Std. examinations for students from Adi Dravidar/Tribal communities.

eligibility.details: One Boy and One Girl each from Adi Dravidar/Tribal / Adi Dravidar Converted to Christianity who have secured highest marks

name: Adi Dravidar and Tribal Welfare Department - Stationary - Text Books
description: Free textbooks for students studying in Adi Dravidar and Tribal welfare schools.

eligibility.details: All students studying in 1st standard to 12th standard in Adi Dravidar and Tribal welfare schools

name: Admission of Adi Dravidar / Tribal students in Plus One at Reputed Schools
description: Admission for outstanding students to reputed private schools for higher secondary education.

eligibility.details: Students who secure the highest marks in X standard from Adi Dravidar/Tribal Welfare schools

name: Chief Minister Merit Award
description: Award for students from Adi Dravidar, Tribal, and Adi Dravidar converted to Christianity communities.

eligibility.details: Top 1000 boys and 1000 girls from the Adi Dravidar, Tribal, and Adi Dravidar Converted to Christianity communities

name: Chief Minister’s Merit Award
description: Merit-based scholarship for students who secure top marks in the 12th Std. Public Examination and continue higher studies.

eligibility.details: First 1000 boys and girls who pass the 12th Std. Public Examination and continue their studies

name: DISTRICT LEVEL PRIZES PUBLIC EXAMINATION 10th and 12th Std.
description: Prizes for the best-performing students in 10th and 12th Std. Public Examinations.

eligibility.details: Top students from Backward, Most Backward, and Denotified Communities

name: ICMR- Post Doctoral Fellowship (ICMR-PDF)
description: ICMR-PDF Scheme is instituted to foster high-quality research opportunities for promising fresh Ph.D./MD/MS holders in basic science, communicable and non-communicable diseases, and reproductive health including nutrition at ICMR Institutes/Centers. The fellowship aims to support fundamental research in cutting-edge areas of science and other priority fields identified by ICMR.

eligibility.details: Indian nationals only; Fresh PhDs/MD/MS within three years of completing their degree (awarded) as on the last date of the application; Proposed research work should continue the candidate's Ph.D. or MD/MS research work; Maximum age limit is 32 years, relaxable up to 5 years for SC/ST/OBC/PH and women candidates; Deserving candidates may receive an additional 3 years' relaxation based on prior work, publications, and awards.

required_docs: Attested copy of School Leaving/High School Certificate for date of birth
Attested copies of Mark Sheets/Grade Cards & Degrees
Attested copies of Letter(s) of Acceptance for paper(s) accepted for publication
Testimonials from two referees (one should be the Ph.D. Guide)
Plagiarism Check Report verified by ICMR-RIO.

name: Dr. Ambedakar Centrally Sponsored Scheme of Post-Matric Scholarships for the Economically Backward Class (EBC) Students
description: The objective of the scheme is to provide financial assistance to Economically Backward Class (EBC) students studying at the post-matriculation or post-secondary stage in India. Scholarships are awarded by the Government of the State/Union Territory to which the applicant belongs. The scheme is designed to enable students to complete their education.

details: Indian nationals belonging to the General Category (other than Schedule Caste, Schedule Tribe, and Other Backward Classes)
Students pursuing recognized post-matriculation or post-secondary courses in Government institutions in India
Students pursuing post-graduate courses in medicine (provided they are not allowed to practice during the course)
Income from all sources of the student's parents/guardians should not exceed ₹1,00,000 per annum
Students must not be studying in commercial pilot license or aviation-related courses
Only two boys of the same parents/guardians are eligible to receive the scholarship, though this restriction does not apply to girls

name: AICTE - Research Promotion Scheme (RPS)
description: The scheme 'AICTE - Research Promotion Scheme (RPS)' was introduced by the All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE), Department of Higher Education (DoHE) to promote research in identified thrust areas of technical education. AICTE-approved Technical Institutions/University Departments with relevant PG programs and full-time regular faculty with research experience and publications are eligible to apply.

details: AICTE-approved Technical Institutions/University Departments with relevant PG programs.
Full-time regular faculty with research experience and publications.
Preliminary research facilities should be available in the institute.
One proposal from one PI (Principal Investigator) will be sanctioned at any point in time within the duration of the project.

Maximum number of proposals acceptable per institute (including those sanctioned earlier but not completed) shall be five for Govt. institutes and three for Pvt. institutes. However, the maximum number of proposals acceptable to be approved per institute shall be two for both Govt. and Pvt. institutes.

required_docs: APR, AUC, R&P, Statement of Expenditure on completion of each financial year.
Copies of GFR-19, copies of bills & vouchers, and stock entry register duly attested.

name: Fellowship for Superannuated Faculty Members
description: The 'Fellowship for Superannuated Faculty Members' scheme is a fellowship scheme by the University Grants Commission (UGC), Department of Higher Education, to provide opportunities to superannuated faculty members of Universities/Institutes/Colleges to pursue research in their area(s).

details: Faculty members at the level of Professors/Associate Professors (who are going to superannuate within six months or already superannuated) from the following institutions:
Universities (including constituent and affiliated colleges/institutions) included under Section 2(f) of the UGC Act, 1956, and having valid accreditation from NAAC.
Deemed to be Universities under Section 3 of the UGC Act 1956 and having valid accreditation from NAAC.
Institutions fully funded by Central or State Governments and empowered to award Degrees.
Institutions of National Importance.
Age: Up to 67 years.
The applicant must have successfully supervised the Ph.D. dissertations of 10 full-time candidates, 3 of whom have received their degrees during the preceding 10 years.
The applicant must have handled, as Principal Investigator, at least 3 sponsored research projects funded by national/international agencies.
The applicant shall not hold any administrative responsibility during the tenure of the fellowship, which would be from the date of superannuation.
The applicant and Institutions shall have to provide an undertaking in the application as per Annexure-I.

required_docs: Scanned copy of your passport-size photograph and signature (size up to 1MB, format: jpg).
Complete Research proposal (size up to 5 MB) and an abstract (size up to 1MB).
Auto-generated application form (after filling out the form), signed by HoD/Registrar, and uploaded before submission.

Proof of being a single girl child (if applicable) via an affidavit on a ₹ 100/- stamp paper, duly attested by SDM/First Class Magistrate/Tahsildar. If parents are not alive, the affidavit can be submitted by the guardian (size: less than 1MB).

name: AICTE-Margdarshan Scheme
description: The Margdarshan Initiative, introduced by the All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE) in 2018, aims to improve the quality of technical education through accreditation by facilitating access to resources and mentorship. The scheme involves Mentor Institutes (MIs) and Mentee Beneficiary Institutes (MBIs) to foster a supportive ecosystem for quality enhancement in AICTE-approved institutes.

For Margdarshan Institute or Mentor Inst: AICTE-approved institutions or Central Funded Institutions (e.g., IITs, NITs, IIITs, IISc, ISERs, IIMs).
AICTE-approved institutions must have valid accreditation for at least 6 months from the proposal submission date.
Institutions with diploma courses must have a minimum of four accredited diploma programs.
Accreditation status for non-engineering programs (e.g., Management, Hotel Management) must be valid for at least 6 months.
For Mentee Beneficiary Institute (MBI): MBIs must not have been enrolled as MIs or mapped with any other MI previously.
None of their programs should have been accredited in the past ten years.

name: AICTE - Distinguished Chair Professor Fellowship
description: A Fellowship Scheme by the All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE), Ministry of Education, aimed at utilizing the expertise of highly qualified and experienced superannuated professionals who have made exceptional contributions in their respective fields. The fellowship is intended to motivate and inspire students and faculty of AICTE-approved institutes. The fellowship is tenable for a period of three years or until the age of 75 years (extendable till 80 years subject to fitness).

details: The awardee must be a highly qualified superannuated professional in their field.
The awardee should be an acknowledged leader/expert in their field of specialization, with active engagement in research and development.
The awardee should have contributed significantly to the development of society through excellent fieldwork.

name: CBSE Merit Scholarship Scheme For Single Girl Child
description: A scholarship scheme by the Ministry of Education for meritorious Single Girl Students, who are the only child of their parents, and have passed the CBSE Class 10th Examination with 60% or more marks. The scheme aims to recognize the efforts of parents in promoting education among girls and to provide encouragement to meritorious students. The scholarship is ₹500/- per month, paid for a maximum period of two years through ECS/NEFT. The tuition fee should not exceed ₹1,500/- per month during the academic year, with a maximum 10% increase over the next two years. The scholarship is awarded to Indian Nationals only.

details: The applicant must be the single girl child of her family.
The applicant must have secured 60% or more marks in the CBSE Class 10th Examination and be studying in Class 11th & 12th in a CBSE-affiliated school.
The tuition fee should not exceed ₹1,500/- per month during the academic year, with a maximum 10% increase over the next two years.
The applicant must be an Indian National.
The student must continue her school studies in Classes 11th and 12th.
The applicant must have passed the CBSE Class 10th Examination in 2019.
Note: NRI applicants are also eligible, with a maximum tuition fee of ₹6,000/- per month.

name: Collaborative Research Scheme (CRS)
description: Launched by the All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE), the Collaborative Research Scheme (CRS) aims to provide financial support in the form of research grants to young TEQIP (Technical Education Quality Improvement Programme) faculty recruited in TEQIP institutes. The scheme encourages collaboration for research and builds a research community.

details: Proposals must be submitted by a group of at least three faculty members, including one Principal Investigator (PI) from a TEQIP institution and Co-Principal Investigators (Co-PIs) from TEQIP or Non-TEQIP institutions.
One TEQIP faculty from the host institute must be the PI.
Co-PI-1 should preferably be a regular faculty from the host TEQIP institute, belonging to the same department as the PI.
A maximum of two proposals can be submitted by one PI.
Only one proposal per PI will be sanctioned at any given time.
Priority for collaboration should be given to TEQIP mentor institutes, NITs, IITs, or Central Universities in the same state or region.
Additional Co-PIs can be from any institution (TEQIP or Non-TEQIP, India or abroad) or industrial sectors.

name: Swami Vivekananda Single Girl Child Fellowship for Research in Social Sciences
description: A fellowship scheme by the University Grants Commission (UGC) for single girl children pursuing research in Social Sciences. The scheme aims to compensate for the direct costs of higher education for girls who are the only child in their family. It promotes the value of small family norms and encourages the concept of a single girl child in society.

details: The applicant must be a single girl child of her parents pursuing a Ph.D. in Social Sciences in Universities/Colleges/Institutes.
The scheme is not applicable if the family has one son and one daughter.
The applicant must be enrolled in a regular, full-time Ph.D. program in Social Sciences in:
- Universities/Colleges/Institutes included under Section 2(f) and 12(b) of the UGC Act, 1956.
- Deemed to be Universities under Section 3 of the UGC Act, 1956, eligible for UGC grants.
- Central/State Government-funded institutions.
- Institutes of National Importance.
Distance education mode is not covered under the scheme.
Age limit: Up to 40 years for general category and 45 years for SC/ST/OBC/PWD candidates as of the last date of application.
Transgender candidates are eligible as per norms.

name: Emeritus Fellowship
description: The Emeritus Fellowship scheme provides an opportunity for superannuated teachers to pursue active research in their respective fields of specialization in Indian Universities/Colleges/Institutions. The scheme is applicable to institutions under Section 2(f) and 12(b) of the UGC Act, 1956, Deemed to be Universities under Section 3 of the UGC Act, 1956, Central/State Government-funded institutions, and Institutes of National Importance.

details.Target Group: Highly qualified and experienced superannuated teachers of recognized universities/colleges/institutions.
Criteria: Eligibility is based on the quality of research and published work during the teacher's service career.
The awardee can work under this scheme up to the age of 70 years or for two years (non-extendable), whichever is earlier.

name: Post Doctoral Fellowship to Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe Candidates
description: This scheme is initiated to provide SC/ST candidates with an opportunity to undertake advanced studies and research in Science, Engineering & Technology, Humanities, and Social Sciences in Indian Universities/Institutions/Colleges. It aims to support candidates from deprived sections of society in pursuing postdoctoral research.

details.Target Group: Unemployed SC/ST candidates with a Ph.D. degree and aptitude for research.
Criteria: The candidate must have a doctorate degree in the relevant subject, preferably with published research work. Provisional degree certificates are accepted if the degree is not awarded.
Candidates must belong to the Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe category.
Only Ph.D. awarded unemployed candidates are eligible.
Upper age limit: 50 years for male applicants and 55 years for female applicants as of the last date of application.
Candidates must have 50% marks at the UG level and 55% marks at the PG level.
A No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the proposed research place, duly forwarded by the Head of Department and Registrar/Director/Principal, must be uploaded.
Transgender candidates are eligible as per Govt. of India norms.

name: AICTE-Technical University Joint Training Programs for Teachers
description: Launched by the All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE), this scheme aims to provide financial assistance to technical universities to conduct training programs for faculty members. The goal is to improve teaching-learning methodologies and prepare faculty for successful careers in technical education.

eligibility.details: AICTE-approved institutions affiliated with the partner university are eligible to participate.

name: Rajiv Gandhi National Fellowship for Scheduled Caste Candidates
description: The Rajiv Gandhi National Fellowship (RGNF) Scheme for Scheduled Caste is funded by the Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment. It provides financial assistance to SC candidates pursuing full-time M.Phil. and Ph.D. degrees in Sciences, Humanities, Social Sciences, and Engineering & Technology. There are 2000 slots annually, with 3% reserved for Persons with Disabilities (PwD) belonging to SC categories.

details.Target Group: SC candidates who have passed the post-graduation examination and are pursuing full-time research without JRF of UGC-NET or UGC-CSIR NET.
Criteria: The candidate must belong to the SC category and have passed the Post Graduate Examination.
The candidate must be registered for M.Phil./Ph.D.
Transgender candidates are eligible as per Govt. of India norms.

name: National Scheme of Apprenticeship Training
description: The National Scheme of Apprenticeship Training, overseen by the Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education, is managed by four Regional Boards of Apprenticeship/Practical (BOATs/BOPT) in Mumbai, Kanpur, Chennai, and Kolkata. The scheme provides practical training to graduate engineers, diploma holders (Technicians), and 10+2 Vocational pass-outs in approximately 10,000 industrial establishments. It operates under the guidelines of the Central Apprenticeship Council (CAC), a statutory body created under the Apprentices Act, 1961. The primary goal is to bridge the gap in practical experience for fresh graduates and vocational pass-outs. The training duration is one year, with a monthly stipend shared equally between the Central Government and the employer.

details: Graduate Engineers.
Diploma Holders (Technicians).
10+2 Vocational Pass-outs.

name: AICTE e-Shodh Sindhu Scheme (eSS)
description: Launched by the All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE), the e-Shodh Sindhu Scheme (eSS) provides subscriptions to e-Resources such as Web of Science, Scopus, The American Society of Mechanical Engineers (ASME), American Society of Civil Engineers (ASCE), and Bentham Science to institutions. The scheme aims to facilitate access to e-Resources for students, faculty, and researchers, fostering a culture of research and improving the quality of technical education.

details: AICTE-approved Government/Government-aided institutes.
The institute must have a digital library network with internet bandwidth (32 Mbps) and Wi-Fi connectivity, along with one or more static IP addresses.
The proposed coordinator must be a full-time regular faculty member with at least 10 years of teaching and research experience, including publications.
The institute must also identify a co-coordinator with at least 7 years of teaching and research experience.
The institute must have PG courses in:
- Mechanical Engineering (for ASME).
- Civil Engineering (for ASCE).
- Pharmacy (for Bentham Science).
- Any discipline (for Web of Science/Scopus).

name: Financial Support Scheme
description: Implemented by Delhi University, the Financial Support Scheme aims to provide equity and access to quality education for economically weak students. The scheme offers financial support, including a fee waiver for all components of fees (except examination and hostel fees).

details: The student must be a bonafide student of Delhi University.
The student should be enrolled in any UG/PG degree program at a Department/Institution/Centre of Delhi University.
The student's family income should be less than ₹8,00,000/- per annum.

name: Pradhan Mantri Uchchatar Shiksha Protsahan (PM-USP) Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students
description: A scholarship scheme by the Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education, aimed at providing financial assistance to meritorious students from poor families to meet a part of their day-to-day expenses while pursuing higher studies. Scholarships are awarded based on the results of the Higher Secondary/Class 12th Board Examination. A maximum of 82,000 fresh scholarships are provided annually for Graduate/Postgraduate degrees and professional courses like Medical, Engineering, etc.

details: The applicant must be above the 80th percentile of successful candidates in the relevant stream from the respective Board of Examination in Class 12th or equivalent.
The applicant must be pursuing regular degree courses at colleges/institutions recognized by AICTE and respective regulatory bodies.
The gross parental/family income of the applicant should not exceed ₹4,50,000/- per annum.
For renewal, the student must score at least 50% marks in the annual examination and maintain at least 75% attendance.
Students must have a bank account in their name.

name: National Scheme of Incentive to Girls for Secondary Education
description: The National Scheme of Incentive to Girls for Secondary Education aims to promote the enrolment of girls aged 14-18 years at the secondary stage, particularly those who pass class 8th but drop out due to socio-economic reasons. The scheme intends to retain such girls up to class 12th. In 2004-05, the dropout rate for girls from classes 1st to 8th was 50.8%, and from classes 1st to 10th, it was 64%. The scheme addresses the financial constraints faced by parents in educating their girl children.

details: The applicant must be a girl child.
The applicant must belong to Scheduled Caste (SC) or Scheduled Tribe (ST).
The applicant must have passed class 8th from Kasturba Gandhi Balika Vidyalayas (irrespective of SC/ST status).
The applicant must have enrolled in class 9th in State/UT Government, Government-aided, or local body schools in the academic year 2008-09 onwards.

name: Dr. D.S. Kothari Research Grant for Newly Recruited Faculty Members
description: A research grant scheme by the University Grants Commission (UGC), Department of Higher Education (DoHE), aimed at providing opportunities to newly appointed faculty members of Universities/Institutes/Colleges to pursue research in their respective fields. The scheme is open to Assistant Professors appointed against permanent posts, possessing a Ph.D. degree with at least five research papers published in journals of international repute. The tenure of the grant is 2 years, with 132 slots available annually.

details: Faculty members must be regularly appointed and working in:
- Universities/Institutions included under Section 2(f) of the UGC Act, 1956, with valid NAAC accreditation.
- Deemed-to-be Universities under Section 3 of the UGC Act, 1956, with valid NAAC accreditation.
- Institutions fully funded by Central/State Governments and empowered to award degrees.
- Institutions of National Importance.
The applicant must be a newly appointed Assistant Professor against a permanent post.
The Assistant Professor must possess a Ph.D. degree with at least five research papers published in journals of international repute.
The application must be submitted within two years of joining the post.

name: Post Doctoral Fellowship to Women Candidates
description: The UGC has initiated the 'Post Doctoral Fellowship for Women' to support unemployed women holding Ph.D. degrees in their respective subject areas. The scheme aims to accelerate the research potential of women candidates by providing financial assistance for advanced studies and research. The fellowship duration is five years, with no provision for extension, and 100 slots are available annually.

details: The candidate must be unemployed and hold a Ph.D. degree (Provisional Certificate is acceptable if the degree is not awarded).
The candidate must be 55 years of age as of the last date of application submission. Age relaxation of 5 years is applicable for SC/ST/OBC/PwD candidates.
Minimum marks required:
- General Category: 55% at UG level and 60% at PG level.
- Reserved Categories (SC/ST/OBC/PwD): 50% at UG level and 55% at PG level.
A No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the proposed research center, signed by the HOD and Registrar/Principal/Director, must be uploaded.
Transgender candidates are eligible as per Govt. of India norms.

name: Post Graduate Scholarship for GATE/GPAT Qualified Students for Pursuing M.Tech/M.E./M.Pharm - UGC
description: The University Grants Commission (UGC) implements this scholarship scheme to support GATE/GPAT-qualified students pursuing M.Tech, M.E., M.Pharm, and integrated dual-degree courses. The scheme aims to attract talented graduate students to pursue postgraduate education in higher education institutions.

details: GATE/GPAT-qualified students admitted to M.Tech, M.E., M.Pharm, or integrated dual-degree programs in Central, State, Deemed, or Private Universities.
Students must be admitted as full-time scholars.
Government of India policies for SC/ST/OBC/PwD reservations are strictly followed.

name: Post-Graduate Scholarships for Professional Courses for SC/ST Candidates
description: The scheme provides financial assistance to SC/ST candidates for pursuing postgraduate studies in professional courses such as Engineering & Technology, Management, Pharmacy, etc., in recognized Indian Universities/Institutions/Colleges. The objective is to support 1000 SC/ST candidates annually.

details: The student must belong to the SC/ST category.
The candidate must have a graduate degree in the relevant subject and be admitted to a full-time postgraduate course in a recognized University/Institution/College.
Only first-year postgraduate students in the current academic year are eligible.
Eligible Institutions:
- Universities/Institutions/Colleges included under Section 2(f) and 12(B) of the UGC Act.
- Deemed-to-be Universities under Section 3 of the UGC Act, 1956, eligible for UGC grants.
- Central/State Government-funded institutions.
- Institutes of National Importance.

name: AICTE – Mitacs Globalink Research Internship (GRI) Scheme
description: AICTE, in collaboration with Mitacs Canada, offers the Globalink Research Internship (GRI) Program to foster cross-border research partnerships between Canada and India. The program is open to students in Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics (STEM) disciplines. The internship duration is 12 weeks, with a maximum of 300 students accepted annually. The total cost of the program is $12,000 CAD per student, with Mitacs contributing $9,000 CAD and AICTE contributing $3,000 CAD. The program covers airfare, visa, medical, stipend, accommodation, and research costs, along with access to professional development activities in Canada.

details: The applicant must be a 3rd-year full-time undergraduate student (B.E/B.Tech) in an AICTE-approved institution.
The applicant must have a minimum CGPA/GPA of 85% in the 2nd year.
The applicant must be at least 18 years old.
The applicant must be available to spend 12 weeks in Canada between May and September for a research project.
The applicant must demonstrate fluency in English or French, depending on the project's primary language.

name: Savitribai Jyotirao Phule Fellowship for Single Girl Child (SJSGC)
description: The fellowship is provided by the University Grants Commission (UGC), Department of Higher Education, for pursuing research work leading to the award of a Ph.D. degree. This fellowship is specifically for the single girl child, i.e., the only girl child in the family without any brother or sister. The scheme is aimed to support the higher education of single girl children in Social Sciences.

details.Single Girl Child: Only the single girl child of the parents
details.Ph.D. Program: Must be enrolled in a regular, full-time Ph.D. program
details.Terms and Conditions: Both the scholar and institution must ensure eligibility and adherence to scheme terms

name: Saksham scheme for specially-abled students
description: Saksham is a Scholarship Scheme by the Ministry of Education, implemented by AICTE, aimed at providing encouragement and support to specially-abled children to pursue technical education. It provides financial assistance to specially-abled students enrolled in diploma level courses at AICTE-approved institutions. The scholarship covers various expenses such as college fees, books, equipment, and more, for a maximum of 3 years for first-year students and 2 years for second-year lateral entry students.

details.Admission: Candidate should be admitted to the First year or Second year (lateral entry) of a Diploma level course in AICTE-approved institutions.
details.Disability: Specially-abled students with a disability of not less than 40%
details.Family Income: Family income should not exceed ₹8 lakh per annum during the current financial year (Income certificate required)

name: Coaching for SC/ST/OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) & Minority Communities
description: The scheme provides coaching to students belonging to SC, ST, OBC (non-creamy layer), and minority communities to help bridge the educational gap and enhance their competitiveness in pursuing higher education. The scheme includes remedial coaching, coaching for entry into services, and coaching for NET/SET exams, targeting both undergraduate and postgraduate students.

details.Institutions: Universities and colleges eligible under Section 2(f) and Section 12(B) of the UGC Act, 1956.
Student Criteria: Sufficient number of SC/ST/OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) & Minority Community students
General candidates with BPL cards may also apply.
Up to 40% of OBC (non-creamy layer) and poor general candidates may be considered if sufficient minority students are unavailable.

name: Junior Research Fellowship (JRF) & Research Associateship (RA) for Foreign Students and Teachers
description: The scheme aims to provide an opportunity for foreign students and teachers from developing countries in Asia, Africa, and Latin America to undertake advanced study and research leading to M.Phil/Ph.D. and postdoctoral research in sciences, humanities, and social sciences at Indian Universities.

details.Target Group: Students and teachers from developing countries in Asia, Africa, and Latin America.

Academic Qualification: High-class master’s degree with a second-class bachelor’s degree or
Second-class master’s degree with a first-class bachelor’s degree
Doctorate degree with published research work

name: Dr. D.S. Kothari Post Doctoral Fellowships in Sciences
description: Introduced by the University Grants Commission, Dept. of Higher Education, to provide a flexible Post Doctoral Fellowship scheme with fast-track online handling and decision-making.

eligibility.details: Ph.D. awarded unemployed candidates in relevant subjects with published research work; upper age limit of 35 years, with relaxation for SC/ST/OBC/Women candidates as per Government of India norms.

required_docs: Joining Report (prescribed format) signed by Head of Department and countersigned by Registrar.
Contingency utilization certificate (end of each year).

name: Innovation In Science Pursuit For Inspired Research (INSPIRE) - Faculty Fellowship
description: Provides opportunities for 100 young researchers annually with Ph.D. qualifications to carry out independent research in science, technology, medicine, agriculture, pharmacy, and veterinary sciences. The fellowship aims to develop independent scientific profiles and augment high-quality manpower in scientific institutions.

eligibility.details: Indian citizens or People of Indian Origin with Ph.D. degrees in relevant fields, aged 27-32 years (relaxed for SC/ST/Women up to 37 years, and Divyangjan up to 42 years). Candidates must have a minimum of 60% marks throughout their academic career and publications in reputed journals. Applicants awaiting their Ph.D. award can apply but must secure their degree before selection confirmation.

required_docs: Class X Mark Sheet or Certificate (proof of Date of Birth)
Academic certificates from Class XII onwards

name: Junior Research Fellowship (JRF) - Department of Biotechnology (DBT)
description: The DBT Junior Research Fellowship (JRF) program provides financial support to Indian students pursuing doctoral research in biotechnology and life sciences. It is open to candidates with a master's degree in biotechnology or related fields.

eligibility.details: 1. Applicant must be an Indian citizen. 2. Must have a master's degree in biotechnology or a related field from a recognized university. 3. Should have cleared the GATE or NET exam in biotechnology or a related field. 4. Age limit: 28 years for General and EWS candidates, and 33 years for SC/ST/PH candidates. 5. Must be willing to pursue full-time doctoral research in biotechnology or a related field at a recognized university or research institution in India.

required_docs: 1. BET exam scorecard. 2. Research proposal. 3. No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the current employer (if applicable). 4. Passport-size photograph. 5. Signature. 6. Date of birth proof. 7. Academic transcripts for all degrees obtained. 8. Category certificate (if applicable). 9. Persons with Disability (PWD) certificate (if applicable).

name: Scholarships to Students with Disabilities Scheme
description: The scheme, initiated by the Department of Social Security and Women & Child Development, Government of Punjab in 1996, aims to assist students with disabilities in securing education, academic, technical, or professional training to help them earn a living and integrate as contributing members of society. It is fully state-sponsored.

eligibility.details: 1. Applicant must be a student in Punjab with a disability of 40% or more (as per the RPwD Act 2016). 2. The monthly family/guardian income should not exceed ₹5,000/- per month. 3. The candidate should have secured at least 40% marks in the previous annual examination. 4. Applicable for students with disabilities from 1st class onwards.

required_docs: 1. Disability Certificate/ UDID showing 40% or more disability. 2. Income certificate showing annual family income below ₹60

name: Stipend to Scheduled Caste Trainees in Technical Training Institutions
description: This scheme, implemented by the Adi Dravidar Welfare and Scheduled Tribes Welfare Department, Union Territory of Puducherry, provides financial support to Scheduled Tribe candidates/trainees undergoing training in Government Technical Training Institutions within the Union Territory of Puducherry.

eligibility.details: 1. Candidates/trainees undergoing training in the Government Technical Training Institutions of Puducherry. 2. The candidate must belong to the Scheduled Caste community. 3. There is no income limit to apply under the scheme.

required_docs: 1. Identity proof (Aadhaar Card). 2. Passport size photograph. 3. Educational documents (Mark sheets). 4. Caste certificate. 5. Nativity Certificate issued by the Competent Revenue Officials. 6. Bank account details. 7. Any other document

name: Post Graduate Indira Gandhi Scholarship For Single Girl Child
description: A scholarship scheme by the University Grants Commission (UGC) for girl students admitted to the first year of PG courses in any designated university or postgraduate college, provided they are the only girl child in their family. The scheme aims to support the postgraduate education of single girl children and promote the value of small family norms.

eligibility.details: 1. The applicant must be a citizen of India. 2. The applicant must be the only girl child in the family. 3. Girl students without brothers or who are twin/fraternal daughters may apply. 4. The age of the applicant should not exceed 30 years at the time of admission to the first year of the PG course. 5. The applicant must have taken admission to a regular, full-time first-year Master’s Degree course in a designated university or postgraduate college. 6. The course must be non-professional, and the student must attend regular classes. 7. Students pursuing education through distance mode are not eligible.

name: Award of Opportunity Cost to Parents of Scheduled Caste Girl Students
description: Implemented by the Adi Dravidar Welfare Department, Government of Puducherry, this scheme aims to financially assist Scheduled Caste parents for sending their daughters to school. It provides opportunity cost compensation to eliminate child labor and encourage education among Scheduled Caste girl students.

eligibility.details: 1. The student must be a girl studying in Class VI to XII in a Government or Government-recognized institution in Puducherry. 2. The student must belong to the Scheduled Caste community. 3. The girl student and her parent/guardian must be a native of Puducherry by birth or continuous residence for at least 3 years. 4. The annual income of the parents should not exceed ₹24,000. 5. Opportunity cost is payable only if the girl student has been promoted to the next higher class.

required_docs: Residence-cum-nativity certificate issued by the competent authority

name: India-Afghanistan Fellowship Programme
description: Started in 2010-11, the India-Afghanistan Fellowship Programme supports agricultural human resource development in Afghanistan. It offers fellowships for Afghan nationals to pursue Bachelor's, Master's, and Ph.D. degrees in Indian Agricultural Universities (AUs) in agriculture and allied sciences.

details.General Requirement: Good knowledge of English for all programmes.

Bachelor's Degree Programme.Academic Qualification: Passed 10+2 examination with Physics, Chemistry, and Biology/Mathematics or both.

Master's Degree Programme.Academic Qualification: Four-year Bachelor's degree in agriculture or related subjects.
Additional Requirements: For M.V.Sc.: Passed B.V.Sc. & A.H. with internship under a 5-year degree programme.
For M.Tech.: Passed B.Tech. or B.E. programme.
Minimum OGPA: 5.50/10 or equivalent percentage of marks at the Bachelor's degree level.

Doctoral Programme.Academic Qualification: Master's degree in the respective or related subject.
Doctoral Programme.Minimum OGPA: 6.5/10 or equivalent percentage of marks at the Master's degree level.

name: Young Interns Program (YIP)
description: An internship program by the Government of Rajasthan providing opportunities for youth to gain practical experience in government programs, schemes, and projects.

eligibility.details: Applicants aged 21 to 30 with postgraduate qualifications (minimum 60% marks) or graduates in Engineering, Medical, Law, CA, or CS streams with minimum 60% marks.

name: Technology Development & Utilization Programme for Women (TDUPW)
description: A program by DSIR to promote technology development, utilization, and capability building specifically for women.

For Projects: Studies/surveys for assessing technology-related information needs of women.
Documentation and content development on technologies beneficial to women, including food processing, water conservation, health, and hygiene.
Establishing consultancy cells for imparting technical knowledge.
Awareness creation and training for women in production activities and community management.
Case studies of successful R&D, technology development, and businesswomen.
For Institutions: Organizations in the government, non-government, or professional sectors working on women's technology development.

Institutions receiving annual grants from central/state government agencies, universities, R&D institutions, public sector undertakings, or registered under the Societies Registration Act, Companies Act, or Indian Trusts Act.

required_docs: Letter of forwarding the project proposal and undertaking from the institution head.
Certificate of Responsibility and Commitment from Investigators.
Technical and financial details of the proposal.
For non-government institutions: Registration Certificate, Annual Report (last 3 years), Auditor’s Report (last 3 years).

name: Top Class Education For Students With Disabilities
description: A scholarship scheme by DoEPwDs for Students with Disabilities (SwDs) pursuing studies beyond class 12th in a full-time course in notified institutions. It aims to support SwDs in pursuing higher education and achieving a dignified place in society.

Student: Admitted in a full-time course in a notified institution.
Percentage of disability should be 40% or above.
Pursuing a Graduate or Post Graduate Degree or Diploma.
Total annual income of Parent/Guardian should be ≤ ₹6.00 Lakh.
Not more than two children with disabilities in the same family can avail of the scholarship.

name: Innovation In Science Pursuit For Inspired Research (INSPIRE) Fellowship
description: The INSPIRE Fellowship is part of the INSPIRE scheme by the Department of Science and Technology (DST), Government of India, aimed at attracting students to pursue doctoral degrees in basic and applied sciences, including engineering, medicine, agriculture, veterinary sciences, and pharmacy.

Primary Eligibility: 1st Rank Holders in any recognized University/Institution in PG level examinations in Basic/Applied Sciences, Engineering, Pharmacy, Agricultural Sciences, Veterinary Sciences.
1st Rank Holders in Medicine at Graduate/Post-Graduate level conducted by an Indian University/Institution.
INSPIRE Scholars with at least 70% marks (or CGPA equivalent) in M.Sc./Integrated M.S./M.Sc. or equivalent.
Additional Notes: Fulfilling eligibility criteria does not guarantee final fellowship award.
Selection based on academic merit, research proposal, supervisor’s credentials, and host institution.

name: Pre Matric Scholarship for Students with Disabilities
description: This scholarship is for students with disabilities studying in Class 9th or 10th in a government-recognized school. The scheme is aimed at providing financial support to students with disabilities to continue their education and find opportunities for a dignified life.

details.Age & Class: The applicant must be studying in Class 9th or 10th.
details.Disability: The applicant must have a disability of 40% or more.
details.Income Limit: The total annual income of the parents/guardians should not exceed ₹2.00 Lakh.
details.Exclusivity: The applicant must not be availing of any other government scholarship, and must not be the third sibling receiving this scholarship.

name: Prime Minister’s Scholarship Scheme (PMSS) for Railway Protection Force (RPF)
description: Introduced by the Hon’ble Prime Minister of India in 2005 and implemented from 2008-09, the PMSS is aimed at encouraging higher technical and professional education for the dependent wards of Ex/Serving RPF/RPSF personnel and widows (below the rank of Gazetted officer).

details.Applicants: Dependent wards of Ex/Serving RPF/RPSF personnel and widows (below the rank of Gazetted officer).
details.Course Limitations: Only regular courses from institutes/universities/colleges with AISHE recognition. No distance learning courses.
Courses Eligible: Other Government Recognized Professional Degree Courses
details.Nationality: Students studying abroad are not eligible.

name: Free Education for Sports Medal Winners / Participants of National/International Events
description: This scheme provides financial assistance to medal winners and elite sports persons who participate in national or international sporting events and are studying in full-time regular courses at recognized universities/colleges. The objective is to motivate sports persons to achieve higher levels of performance by assisting them financially for education and sports development.

details.Eligible Candidates: Medal winners in national games or participants in recognized international sporting events.
Institutions: Universities/Institutions/Colleges under sections 2(f) and 12(b) of the UGC Act, 1956.
Deemed to be Universities under section 3 of the UGC Act, 1956.
details.Subsequent Eligibility: Scholarship eligibility in subsequent years depends on the student’s performance in both sports and academics.

name: Indian Agricultural Research Institute - Scholarship
description: The scholarship provides financial support to students enrolled in M.Sc. and Ph.D. courses at the Indian Agricultural Research Institute (IARI). The awards are based on merit and performance at the Post Graduate School, with a duration of up to two years for M.Sc. students and three years for Ph.D. students. Extensions may be granted in exceptional cases.

M.Sc./M.Tech. (Agricultural Engineering).Educational Qualification: Bachelor's degree under 10+2+4, 10+2+3, or 10+1+4 system. B.Sc. degree under 10+2+2 system prior to 1985.

Ph.D. Courses.Minimum Marks Required: 60% or OGPA of 7.50 out of 10 for General/OBC candidates, 55% or OGPA of 7.00 out of 10 for SC/ST/PC candidates.

General Eligibility.Nationality: Indian nationals or persons domiciled in India
General Eligibility.Age Limit: Minimum age for Ph.D. admission: 21 years as of 31st July of the year of admission
General Eligibility.Other Criteria: Fellows must devote full time to study and cannot hold another paid or unpaid appointment.

name: Scholarship to 2 Years Pre-Service Student Teachers undergoing D.El.Ed Programme at DIETs and CTTC Sohra
description: Launched by the Department of Education, Government of Meghalaya in April 2012, this scholarship aims to attract the best talent to pursue teaching as a profession. It provides financial support to students undertaking the D.El.Ed programme at DIETs and CTTC Sohra, with a focus on improving the quality of education in rural areas.

details.Age Limit: 18 to 27 years (Relaxation of 5 years for SC/ST/OBC/PWD candidates).

Educational Qualifications.Class XII: Passed or equivalent examination with 50% marks (5% relaxation for ST/SC/OBC/PWD).
Educational Qualifications.Waiting for Results: Candidates awaiting Class XII results can apply, with the condition to produce provisional/original documents during counseling.

details.Other Criteria: Must be interested in becoming a teacher.

name: Internship Scheme For PG/Research Students In Directorate General Of Trade Remedies (DGTR)
description: The Internship Scheme by the Directorate General of Trade Remedies (DGTR), Department of Commerce, Ministry of Commerce & Industry, provides an opportunity for young scholars, especially from Law/Economics streams, to learn about trade remedial investigations and trade defence measures.

details.Student Status: Applicants must be Postgraduate Students or Research Scholars from a recognized University/Institute.
details.Course Requirement: The internship must be a part of the applicant's course curriculum (may extend to a semester) or an additional assignment during annual vacations.

name: Internship Scheme of the Department of Economic Affairs
description: The Department of Economic Affairs offers an internship program to postgraduate and PhD students specializing in Economics, Law, Finance, and Management. The aim is to familiarize students with the process of formulating economic policies at the macro level and to provide them with an opportunity to research specific economic issues such as macro-economic management, capital markets, inflation management, and fiscal policy.

eligibility.details: The program is open to outstanding candidates pursuing Post Graduation or PhD in Economics, Law, Finance, or Management from universities or institutions ranked within the top 25 according to the National Institutional Ranking Framework (NIRF) or from QS-ranked international universities.

required_docs: Proof of identity (e.g., Aadhar card or passport)
Proof of address (e.g., utility bill or bank statement)
Proof of the latest educational qualification (degree, mark sheets)
Identity card or proof of enrolment in the postgraduate or PhD program
Letter of recommendation from the institution
Bank account details for payment of stipend

name: ICAR - Post Matric Scholarship For Scheduled Caste / Scheduled Tribes Candidates
description: The Post-Matric Scholarship scheme by the Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR) aims to support students from Scheduled Castes (SC) and Scheduled Tribes (ST) communities to pursue undergraduate courses in Agriculture and Allied Sciences. The scholarship helps these students complete their Bachelor's Degree programs, including B.Sc.(Agri.), B.V.Sc., B.Sc.(Agril. Engg.), and more.

eligibility.details: The scholarship is exclusively for SC/ST students, as defined by the Government of India, who have been admitted to Agricultural Universities for any undergraduate degree program in Agriculture and Allied Sciences.

name: Pre-Matric Scholarship
description: The Pre-Matric Scholarship scheme aims to improve the educational status of students from Other Backward Classes (OBC) in Uttar Pradesh. The scheme provides financial support to OBC students studying in government schools, aided, and recognized educational institutes to encourage their education and reduce dropout rates.

eligibility.details: The applicant must be a native of Uttar Pradesh, with an annual income of their parents/guardians up to ₹2 Lakh. The student must be enrolled in government schools, aided, or recognized educational institutes, subject to budget availability.

name: MeitY - Visvesvaraya PhD Scheme For Electronics & IT
description: A scholarship scheme by the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology to enhance the number of PhDs in Electronics System Design & Manufacturing (ESDM) and IT/ITES sectors in the country.

eligibility.details: Applicants must have a minimum Grade Point Average of 6.5/10 or 60% in M.E./M.Tech./M.S. or equivalent in relevant fields, or a Bachelor's degree with a valid GATE score or equivalent.

name: Pre-Matric Scholarships to the Children of Those Engaged in Occupations Involving Cleaning and Prone to Health Hazards
description: A scholarship scheme by the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, to provide financial assistance to children whose parents/guardians are engaged in hazardous occupations such as tanners, flayers, waste pickers, and manual scavengers.

Categories: Persons engaged in Manual Scavenging (under the Manual Scavengers Act, 2013)
Persons engaged in hazardous cleaning (under the Manual Scavengers Act, 2013)
details.Conditions: Children must not be employed or assist in parents' work during studies. The scholarship will be discontinued if the student fails to secure annual promotion or violates school discipline.

name: Central Sector Scheme of National Fellowship for Providing Fellowship to Scheduled Caste Students to Pursue M.Phil. & PhD
description: The fellowship scheme was launched in 2005-06 by the Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment to provide financial assistance to Scheduled Caste (SC) students pursuing M.Phil or Ph.D. in Sciences, Humanities, or Social Sciences from recognized Indian universities.

details.1: Applicant must belong to the Scheduled Caste (SC) category.
details.2: Applicant must be pursuing regular and full-time advanced studies/research leading to an M.Phil/PhD degree.
details.3: Applicant must have qualified one of the following tests: National Eligibility Test - Junior Research Fellowship (NET - JRF) or UGC-CSIR NET-JRF Joint Test.
details.4: Applicant must be enrolled in a University/Institution recognized by UGC under Section 2(f) or Section 3 of the UGC Act, 1956.
details.5: The applicant is eligible for only one fellowship at a time and must not accept any other monetary benefit/scholarship/fellowship from any other source.

name: NPC Students Internship Program
description: The National Productivity Council (NPC) offers internship training to undergraduate and postgraduate students, providing exposure to various interventions and IT-enabled activities undertaken by NPC. This program helps students apply their academic knowledge in real-world scenarios, develop new skills, and gain deeper insights into industrial and technological processes.

details.1: The applicant must be an Indian citizen.
details.2: The applicant must not have already applied for the internship in the current financial year.
details.3: The applicant must be pursuing graduation or post-graduation studies.

name: Department of Expenditure Internship Programme
description: The Department of Expenditure offers an internship program for undergraduates, postgraduates, and research scholars to familiarize them with the process of formulating economic policies of the Government of India. This is not a job or a guarantee for a job in the Department.

General Criteria: Postgraduates in Economics, Finance, Management, or students in the 4th and 5th years of a 5-year integrated Law course or other professional courses.
Specific Criteria: Postgraduate students must have a first-class graduate degree.
Research students must have at least 50% marks in Post-Graduation.
Students in the 4th or 5th year of the 5-year integrated Law course must have at least 80% marks in their 12th-grade examination.

name: Maulana Azad National Fellowship For Minority Students
description: The Maulana Azad National Fellowship for Minority Students was launched in 2009 by the Ministry of Minority Affairs to provide financial aid to students from minority communities to pursue M. Phil and Ph.D. courses at recognized institutions. The fellowship aims to support students from minority communities to further their academic research and higher studies in various fields.

eligibility.details: Students from minority communities (Buddhist, Christian, Jain, Muslim, Sikh, or Zoroastrian) who have qualified for the UGC-NET or Joint CSIR-UGC NET examination. The fellowship is available only for students who have not availed of any fellowship earlier. Employees of any educational institution or government are not eligible.

required_docs: 1. UGC-NET/CSIR-UGC NET Certificate. 2. Continuation Certificate (submitted every three months). 3. Progress Report (submitted after one year of the fellowship). 4. Contingency Grant Account for eligible expenses. 5. HRA Certificate (if applicable). 6. Passport-sized photograph. 7. Write-up (not exceeding 500 words) explaining how the fellowship will contribute to the student's career growth.

name: Long Term Fellowship under the Human Resource Development Programme for Health Research
description: The Long Term Fellowship under the Human Resource Development Programme for Health Research aims to provide advanced training to medical and health research personnel in cutting-edge research areas related to health and medicine. The fellowship targets the creation of a skilled workforce for health research in India, with training opportunities both within India and abroad in priority health research areas.

eligibility.details: Indian citizens working in Indian institutes with at least three years of experience as regular faculty. Applicants should have an M.D./M.S./M.D.S. or equivalent degree like MBBS/BDS/MVSc./M.Sc./M.Pharma/M.Tech or Ph.D. in health/medical research. The applicant should be below 45 years of age and should not have availed any government fellowship of one month or more for the same research area.

name: Junior Research Fellowship in Engineering & Technology
description: The Junior Research Fellowship (JRF) in Engineering & Technology, offered by the University Grants Commission (UGC), is designed for candidates who wish to pursue research leading to a Ph.D. in engineering and technology. This fellowship provides opportunities for M.Pharma, M.E., and M.Tech students through direct interviews conducted by the UGC, as there is no NET examination in these fields.

details.Qualifications: Candidates must hold an M.E./M.Tech. degree or equivalent with at least 55% marks. GATE is not mandatory for applying for this fellowship.
details.Age Limit: The age limit is 40 years as of 1st July of the award year, extendable by five years for women and SC/ST candidates.
details.Reservations: 22.5% of fellowships are reserved for SC/ST candidates who fulfill the qualifications. If SC/ST candidates are unavailable, the slots will be made available to general candidates.

name: National Renewable Energy Internship (NREI) Scheme
description: The NREI Scheme by the Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE) offers internship opportunities for students and professionals to gain experience in the renewable energy sector. The scheme is open to students pursuing undergraduate, graduate, or post-graduate degrees or research scholars in recognized institutions within India or abroad, with a focus on renewable energy.

details.Qualifications: Applicants must be pursuing a graduate or post-graduate degree in Engineering, Management, Law, Science, or Renewable Energy from a recognized institution within India or abroad, or be working in the Renewable Energy field.
details.Additional Notes: MNRE may relax eligibility criteria for deserving candidates.

name: Dr. S. Radhakrishnan UGC Post-Doctoral Fellowship
description: The Dr. S. Radhakrishnan UGC Post-Doctoral Fellowship is provided by the University Grants Commission (UGC) to support post-doctoral research in various disciplines including Sciences, Engineering, Technology, Humanities, Social Sciences, and Languages at Indian Universities/Institutions.

Candidate Eligibility.PhD Requirement: Unemployed candidates with a Ph.D. degree in relevant fields (Sciences, Engineering, Technology, Humanities, Social Sciences, including Languages).
Candidate Eligibility.Age Limit: Below 35 years (with relaxation of 5 years for SC/ST/OBC (Non-Creamy Layer)/Women/PWD/Transgender).
Candidate Eligibility.Other Fellowship: Candidates availing other fellowships/remuneration must resign from them before accepting the UGC fellowship.
Candidate Eligibility.Academic Requirement: Minimum 55% marks at the postgraduate level (5% relaxation for reserved categories).
Candidate Eligibility.Mentor Requirement: Candidates must identify a mentor at a recognized institution and obtain consent.

Mentor Eligibility.Faculty Status: Mentor must be a regular faculty at Associate Professor level or above.
Mentor Eligibility.PhD Requirement: Mentor must have a Ph.D. degree.
Mentor Eligibility.Experience: Mentor must have supervised at least 3 Ph.D. theses.

Institution Types: Universities under section 2(f) of UGC Act, 1956 with valid NAAC accreditation.
Deemed Universities under section 3 of UGC Act, 1956 with valid NAAC accreditation.
Central/State Government funded institutions authorized to award degrees.

name: Padho Pardesh Scheme
description: The Padho Pardesh scheme provides interest subsidies to meritorious minority students pursuing master's, M.Phil, or Ph.D. degrees abroad. It aims to support economically weaker students from notified minority communities in accessing higher education opportunities abroad and enhancing employability.

details.Admission Requirement: Must be admitted to an approved master's, M.Phil, or Ph.D. program abroad in a recognized university/institution.
details.Income Limit: Family income must not exceed ₹6,00,000 per annum.
details.Loan Requirement: Must have obtained an education loan from a scheduled bank under the Indian Banks Association (IBA) Education Loan Scheme.
details.Application Timeframe: Application must be made during the first year of study (applications received in the second year or later will not be accepted).
details.Priority: Priority given to applications from states and union territories with lower bank interest rates.
details.Aadhaar Linking: Payment of financial benefits may be linked to the student's Aadhaar number.

name: Free Coaching Scheme for SC and OBC Students
description: This scheme, implemented by the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment in collaboration with Dr. Ambedkar Foundation (DAF), aims to provide quality coaching to economically disadvantaged SC and OBC students for competitive examinations, thereby enhancing their chances of securing public/private sector jobs or admission to reputed technical and professional higher education institutions.

Student Criteria.Income: Annual family income should be ₹8,00,000 or less

Education.For Class 12th Based Exams: Should have passed class 12th or be studying in class 12th
Education.For Under Graduate Based Exams: Should have completed or be in the final year of an undergraduate course

Student Criteria.Benefits Limit: A student can avail the benefits up to two times, irrespective of the number of attempts for exams.

University Criteria.Seats Allocation: Maximum of 100 seats per Central University, with a minimum of 50 students per university for viability.
University Criteria.Courses Allocation: Each university can offer a maximum of 4 courses, with at least 25 students per course.

Exclusions: Students with less than 50% marks in Class 10th (for 12th-based exams) or Class 12th (for undergrad-based exams) are not eligible.

name: PM-YASASVI: Top Class School Education for OBC, EBC and DNT Students
description: A sub-scheme under PM Young Achievers Scholarship Award Scheme (PM-YASASVI), launched by the Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment to provide educational assistance to meritorious students from OBC, EBC, and DNT categories for studying in top-class schools from Class 9 to Class 12.

Student Criteria.Income: Household income must be less than ₹2.5 Lakhs
Student Criteria.Merit: Must be studying in a top-class school from Class 9 to Class 12

School Criteria.Aadhaar-Based Attendance: Schools must integrate Aadhaar-based attendance system if required.

details.Exclusions: Students receiving benefits under any other government scheme for similar items will not be eligible.

name: Student Internship Program
description: A learning opportunity for students to gain exposure to the functioning of the CAG of India. Interns will be engaged on a contract basis for 3 to 6 months in Regional Capacity Building and Knowledge Institutes.

details.Academic Qualification: Undergraduate, Postgraduate, or Research students from recognized institutions with a stellar academic record
Preferred Attributes: Skills in Information Technology (IT) & Information Communication Technology (ICT)
Other Requirements: Must sign a Secrecy and Non-Disclosure Agreement before reporting for the internship
Must comply with the laws of secrecy of the country
Shall not be entitled to leave during the internship period

name: Internship Programme at Serious Fraud Investigation Office
description: The SFIO Internship Programme aims to provide a platform for young scholars and researchers from reputed academic institutions in fields like Economics, Commerce, Law, Management, Computer Forensics, and professional courses from ICAI, CMA, and ICSI. Interns will gain hands-on experience and interact with officers of SFIO, including its Regional Offices.

details.National: The applicant must be an Indian National
Academic Qualifications: Post Graduate Courses - MBA (Finance), Law Students in 4th/5th Year of a five-year stream with excellent academic records
Post-graduation with at least 55% marks in graduation, pursuing Masters/Research in Economics/Finance/Management/Law/Computer Forensics from recognized universities

Students in the final year or equivalent of ICAI, ICAI(CMA), ICSI, Central Universities, AICTE recognized financial/Economic Institutions, National Management Institutes, Foreign Universities and Institutions of Excellence
For Graduate Applicants - Must have secured First Class Degree in Graduation

name: Merit Cum Means Based Scholarship For Students Belonging To The Minority Communities
description: A scholarship scheme by the Ministry of Minority Affairs for students from minority communities pursuing technical and professional courses at undergraduate and postgraduate levels in listed institutes. The scholarship aims to lighten the financial burden on education for minority communities and provide a level playing field in the competitive employment arena.

details.Community: The applicant must belong to a Minority Community
details.Course: The applicant must be pursuing a technical or professional course at the undergraduate or postgraduate level
details.Marks: The applicant must have secured not less than 50% marks (or equivalent grade) in the previous final examination
details.Income: The annual income of the parents/guardians of the applicant from all sources must be less than or equal to ₹2.5 Lakhs per annum

name: Post Matric Scholarship Scheme for Scheduled Tribe Students
description: A centrally sponsored scholarship scheme by the Ministry of Tribal Affairs for ST students pursuing post-matriculation or post-secondary courses in India.

eligibility.details: Scheduled Tribe students who have passed Matriculation or Higher Secondary examinations or equivalent, and whose parents’/guardians’ combined annual income does not exceed ₹2,00,000.

required_docs: Certificates of examinations passed (Diplomas, Degrees, etc.)
Caste Certificate (signed by Revenue Officer, not below Tahsildar)
Income Declaration (affidavit for self-employed or income certificate for employed parents)
Receipt of last year’s scholarship (for renewal)
